scientific_integrity: The proof supplies the all-order conclusions. The finite diameters are supported by complete enumeration with separately structured Python and C++17 programs and exact output records. No external scientific certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The universal theorem is restricted to orders n=3k+1, k>=1.
Exact graph diameters are established only for n=4,7,10; no larger-order diameter is claimed.

Publication priority may be affected by unindexed paired-domination classifications or colored-token-swapping quotients; full Haynes–Slater article was not accessible and the scanned induced-paired paper was not read in its entirety.
